scope: Frozen original private_lifecycle core only. Reviewer did not author this implementation. No provider/hardware integration, activation or physical retirement approval.

checklist.evidence: One initialized registry has one copied platform/DART/IRQ policy. Every live entry, including quarantined, conflicts on any equal RID or SID or intersecting vector bits. All refusal checks precede slot mutation. Domains are implicit per registry, not authenticated hardware identities. Platform must provide exactly one stable registry; separate instances do not enforce global exclusivity.

checklist.check: Typed spans and cross-lease alias rejection
checklist.evidence: Exact ordered root/leaf/data triple,16KiB each, nonzero numeric handle/generation, aligned bounded CPU and36-bit PA, declared RAM containment and reserved exclusion. Table permissions/IOVA zero; data explicit READ/WRITE bits and aligned bounded IOVA. Handle/CPU/PA conflicts checked within/across every live/quarantined lease, plus data IOVA aliases even across SIDs. CPU spans covering registry rejected. All validation precedes copied metadata commit.

checklist.check: Lease identity and permanent nonzero generation exhaustion
checklist.evidence: Registry pointer, bounded slot, nonzero generation, live state and exact stored generation checked by every lease operation. LastUINT64MAX generation issued at most once and exhausted flag remains after retirement; no wrap/recycle. Stale/foreign tokens refuse without changing another owner. Copies remain references to same claim, not independently admitted owners.

Every byte of registry must initially be zero; initialized magic/policy/next-generation prevent another init even after retirement/exhaustion. Caller mutation/memset/copy/concurrent access explicitly violates contract; no protection against arbitrary privileged storage mutation claimed.

checklist.check: Monotonic possible-exposure ledger before returned ticket
checklist.evidence: Valid generation/phase, one-outstanding bound and32entry capacity checked; exact kind minimum resource mask and bound-table/data requirements enforced. Effect record, count, pending, ever_resources union and EFFECT_RECORDED state are committed before output ticket assignment/return. Core invokes no callbacks; external begin-before-backend ordering and physical visibility remain future caller obligations.

checklist.check: Success cannot erase history; uncertainty is sticky
checklist.evidence: Success changes only pending/result record, never effect_count/ever_resources/state to privately retireable. Failure/UNKNOWN records preserve original nonzero error and quarantine. Current-lease wrong/replayed sequence quarantines; wrong registry/stale lease rejected unchanged. Explicit quarantine is sticky and retains claims/descriptions, including pending uncertainty. Invalid arguments leave pending obligation intact.

Retirement requires CLAIMED or PRIVATE_METADATA and zero effect_count,pending,ever_resources; quarantine and every recorded effect permanently refuse. RETIRED state invalidates lease before conflict scans may reuse metadata slot; later claim uses a fresh generation. Nothing calls complete/free/unmap or releases actual backing.

No ACTIVE state, provider callbacks, allocation, real preparation, mappings, hardware API, drain Boolean, exposed retirement or forced release. Pure metadata implementation is identical under host KERNEL define; not a kernel provider. Missing activation/drain/unmap/force-release API calls compile-refused.

integration_limits.detail: The single registry and common serialization are trusted platform obligations, not enforced across multiple independently initialized registries. Same-domain duplicate registries can each hold identical numeric claims; existing tests explicitly document this. Future provider must bind one registry to actual domain ownership.

The core intentionally implements a narrower prerequisite than the full483b lifecycle design: no real acquisition/preparation/completion pair or callback identity is represented. retire_private means metadata-reservation release only. This does not discharge prepare/complete/free obligations or make the actual physical lifecycle ready.

Data metadata permits explicit READ and/or WRITE. A future H2D adapter must separately enforce the design's device-READ-only ring permission and derive descriptor/IOVA from authenticated same backing. No numerical span currently authenticates that backing or validates a table graph.

CONFIG/IRQ effects can be recorded before binding, but any effect then prevents later binding. External integration must select its private-bind order explicitly. This conservatism is documented and supplies no activation path.
